{"predictors": [
{"name": "Research Intensity", "construction": "R&D expense for the past 3 years divided by total assets, averaged over the same period", "rationale": "Firms investing heavily in R&D may experience future growth and returns as a result of innovation, but also face higher uncertainty and risk.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Advertising Efficiency", "construction": "Advertising expense for the past year divided by the change in sales over the same period", "rationale": "Firms with efficient advertising spend may see increased brand recognition and customer loyalty, leading to higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth", "construction": "3-year average annual growth rate of total employees", "rationale": "Firms experiencing rapid employee growth may be indicative of expanding operations and future success, but also face challenges in maintaining corporate culture.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Real Estate Ownership", "construction": "Total property, plant, and equipment divided by total assets, averaged over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with significant real estate holdings may benefit from appreciating property values and reduced rent expenses, but also face illiquidity and management challenges.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Pension Funding Ratio", "construction": "Pension assets divided by pension liabilities, averaged over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with well-funded pensions may experience lower future liabilities and increased financial flexibility, leading to higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Levered Cash Flow Volatility", "construction": "Standard deviation of debt-financed cash flow (EBITDA - interest expense) over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with volatile debt-financed cash flow may face higher risk of default and financial distress, leading to lower returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Board Independence", "construction": "Percentage of independent board members (not employed by the firm) over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with independent boards may experience improved governance and decision-making, leading to higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Liability", "construction": "Environmental provisions and liabilities divided by total assets, averaged over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with significant environmental liabilities may face future cleanup costs and reputational damage, leading to lower returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Turnover Acceleration", "construction": "Year-over-year change in inventory turnover ratio (COGS / average inventory) over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms experiencing accelerating inventory turnover may be indicative of improved operational efficiency and future growth.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Capital Expenditure Reversal", "construction": "Year-over-year change in capital expenditures divided by total assets, averaged over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with reversing capital expenditure trends may be indicative of changing business conditions and future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
